title: Billing Incident Handling — Quick Reference
content:
## Billing Incident Handling

For billing incident handling procedures, see the Billing Incident SOP.

General guidance:
- Review all open billing tickets before taking action.
- Identify tickets that share a common root cause (e.g., same cluster failure).
- Distinguish billing incidents from routine requests (reports, access, documentation).
- Do NOT close any ticket — leave resolution to the on-call billing engineer.
- Output one line per updated ticket: TICKET_ID|priority|category|why

Note: The full SOP with specific escalation thresholds, priority labels, category assignments, and required tags is maintained separately. Consult the latest version of the Billing Incident SOP for exact rules.
